description: Switch tile layer from Breton OSM to CartoDB Positron for a clean, data-focused base map
steps: Open components/near-me/near-me-map.tsx
Replace the tile URL from 'https://tile.openstreetmap.bzh/ca/{z}/{x}/{y}.png' to 'https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png'
Update attribution text to CartoDB and OpenStreetMap contributors
Update subdomains option to ['a','b','c','d']
Verify map renders a light grey/white base with minimal labels
Verify teal markers are visually prominent against the new base
Check tile loads correctly on both desktop and mobile viewports

description: Clicking a map marker opens a rich floating popup card with place details inline on the map
steps: In near-me-map.tsx, create a makePopupContent(place, index) function that renders a card with: numbered index, thumbnail image, place name, star rating badge, type, open/closed status, and Directions + Call buttons
Replace marker.bindTooltip() with marker.bindPopup() using the new popup HTML content
Style popup with white background, rounded corners, 280px max-width, and minuri-teal accent on the selected state
Add closeButton: true and autoPan: true to popup options
Ensure clicking Directions or Call inside popup does not also trigger onSelectPlace
Verify popup appears above the marker anchor point without being clipped by the map edge
Verify popup closes when clicking another marker or the map background
Verify popup shows placeholder icon when thumbnail is absent

description: Hovering a list row highlights the corresponding map marker; hovering a map marker subtly highlights the list row
steps: Add hoveredPlaceId state (string | null) to near-me-view.tsx alongside selectedPlaceId
Pass hoveredPlaceId and onHoverPlace callback as props to NearMeMap
In NearMeMap, add mouseover and mouseout event listeners to each marker
On mouseover, call onHoverPlace(place.id); on mouseout, call onHoverPlace(null)
In makePinIcon(), accept a hovered boolean and render a slightly larger size (32px) with an opacity ring when hovered and not active
In DetailList, CardGridList, and CompactList, add onMouseEnter and onMouseLeave handlers on each row div
Apply a bg-minuri-teal/8 background to the hovered row when it is not already selected
Verify hovering a list row causes the corresponding map pin to visually enlarge
Verify hovering a map pin causes the corresponding list row to highlight
Verify hover state clears correctly on mouseout without affecting the selected state

description: Map markers animate in with a staggered cascade when results first load, instead of appearing all at once
steps: In near-me-map.tsx, add a CSS keyframe animation 'markerDrop' (scale 0 -> 1, translateY -8px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1) via a <style> tag injected once on mount
When creating markers in the places useEffect, assign each divIcon's inner element a style of animation-delay: {i * 40}ms
Keep animation duration at 280ms with an ease-out curve
Verify markers appear sequentially from first to last result rather than all simultaneously
Verify animation respects prefers-reduced-motion by omitting the animation when the media query matches
Verify re-searching a suburb replays the animation for the new result set

description: 'Search this area' button appears when user pans or zooms the map away from the current suburb center
steps: Add a showSearchArea state (boolean) to NearMeMap, initialised to false
Attach a moveend event listener to the map instance after initialisation
On moveend, calculate the distance between the map center and the original fitBounds center; if > 800m, set showSearchArea to true
Render a floating pill button 'Search this area' centered at the top of the map div, z-index 800, visible only when showSearchArea is true
On button click, emit an onSearchArea(center: LatLng) callback prop to near-me-view.tsx
In near-me-view.tsx, on receiving onSearchArea, reverse-geocode the lat/lng to the nearest suburb using the /api/suburbs endpoint and call pickSuburb()
Hide the button when a new fetch starts (status === 'loading')
Verify button appears after panning at least 800m from the original center
Verify clicking it re-fetches results for the new suburb
Verify button disappears once results load

description: A pulsing blue dot appears at the user's GPS position when 'Use my location' is activated
steps: Extend NearMeMap props to accept userLat and userLng (number | null)
In near-me-view.tsx, store geolocation coords in a userCoords state when useMyLocation() succeeds via navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition()
Pass userCoords to NearMeMap

In NearMeMap, create an L.circleMarker at userCoords with radius 8, fillColor '#3b82f6', color white, weight 2, and a CSS pulse animation on a second larger circle (radius 16, opacity 0.3, animating to opacity 0 and radius 24)
Ensure the user dot renders above all place markers via a higher zIndexOffset
Remove the user dot marker when userLat/userLng become null
Verify dot appears at the correct GPS position on the map
Verify pulse animation runs continuously
Verify dot is not shown when the user has not activated location

description: Map marker color reflects the active Near Me topic rather than a single teal for all topics
steps: In near-me-map.tsx, define a TOPIC_COLORS map: survive -> '#e07b39' (amber), health -> '#3a8a5a' (green), get-around -> '#3a6aaa' (blue), setup -> '#2a8a7a' (teal), connect -> '#7a6aaa' (soft purple)
Extend NearMeMapProps to accept topic: NearMeTopic
Pass the current topic from near-me-view.tsx to NearMeMap
Update makePinIcon() to accept color (string) and use TOPIC_COLORS[topic] for inactive markers, and a darkened version for active markers
Verify each topic tab produces distinctly colored markers on the map
Verify active marker is a visibly darker shade of the topic color
Verify markers update color immediately when the user switches topic tabs

description: Selecting a map marker on mobile shows a slide-up bottom sheet with place details without requiring the user to switch to the list pane
steps: In near-me-view.tsx, add a mobileMapCard state that stores the selected NearMePlace or null
When mobilePane === 'map' and onSelectPlace fires, set mobileMapCard to the selected place
Render a fixed bottom sheet div inside the map container: position fixed, bottom 0, left 0, right 0, z-50, white background, rounded-t-2xl, shadow-xl, translate-y animation (hidden -> visible)

Sheet content: thumbnail (h-28 w-full object-cover), place name, rating badge, type + open status, address, and two action buttons: 'Directions' (links to Google Maps) and 'Call' (tel: link, only if phone exists)
Render an X close button in the top-right corner of the sheet that sets mobileMapCard to null
Clicking another marker replaces the sheet content with the new place
Verify sheet slides up smoothly when a marker is tapped on mobile
Verify sheet shows correct data for the tapped place
Verify sheet is not visible on desktop (lg:hidden wrapper)
Verify X button and tapping outside the sheet dismisses it

description: Phone number from SerpAPI is extracted and displayed on place cards and mobile sheet
steps: In lib/near-me-api.ts, add phone?: string | null to the NearbyInterestRecord type
Verify the backend Python service forwards the 'phone' field from the SerpAPI Google Local response
In near-me-view.tsx fetchPlaces(), map place.phone to the NearMePlace phone field (currently always undefined)
In DetailList, confirm the existing phone action button renders when place.phone is truthy (this is already built at line 806 but never receives data)
In CardGridList, add a phone action button matching the DetailList style when place.phone is truthy
In the mobile bottom sheet, add a 'Call' button when place.phone is truthy
In the map popup card, add a phone number line with a call icon when place.phone is truthy
Verify phone number displays correctly formatted (e.g. '(03) 9123 4567') on all surfaces
Verify tapping the phone link opens the native dialler on mobile

description: Website URL from SerpAPI is extracted and shown as a 'Visit website' action on place cards
steps: In lib/near-me-api.ts, add website?: string | null to NearbyInterestRecord
In lib/near-me.ts, add website?: string to NearMePlace
Verify the backend Python service forwards the 'website' field from SerpAPI
In near-me-view.tsx fetchPlaces(), map place.website to NearMePlace.website
In DetailList and CardGridList, add a 'Visit website' anchor tag next to the Directions button when place.website is truthy
Ensure the link opens in a new tab with rel='noreferrer'
Truncate displayed domain to hostname only (e.g. 'melbourneclinic.com.au') not full URL
Verify website link renders only when data is present and does not break layout when absent

description: Service options (dine-in, takeaway, delivery) from SerpAPI are surfaced as tags on Survive topic cards
steps: In lib/near-me-api.ts, add service_options?: string[] | null to NearbyInterestRecord
In lib/near-me.ts, add serviceOptions?: string[] to NearMePlace
Map service_options from SerpAPI response to NearMePlace.serviceOptions in fetchPlaces()
In CardGridList (used for Survive topic), render serviceOptions as small tag chips below the type line when topic === 'survive'
Style chips with bg-minuri-teal/10 text-minuri-teal text-[10px] rounded-full px-2 py-0.5
Cap display at 3 options maximum to avoid overflow
Verify chips appear on food/restaurant cards with relevant options like 'Dine-in', 'Takeaway'
Verify chips do not appear on non-Survive topic cards

description: Star rating badge is hidden on the Connect topic — belonging is not ranked
steps: In near-me-view.tsx, pass topic to CompactList as a prop
In CompactList, conditionally suppress the rating display when topic === 'connect'
In the map popup card, suppress the rating line when topic === 'connect'
Verify Connect tab place cards show no rating badge
Verify all other topic tabs continue to show ratings where available
Verify the layout does not shift or leave empty space where the badge was

description: Health tab cards show a 'Bulk-billing: call to confirm' nudge in place of price tags, since SerpAPI does not return clinical billing data
steps: In near-me-view.tsx, when topic === 'health' and place.tags is empty or absent, inject a synthetic tag: 'Bulk-billing: call to confirm'
Style this tag with bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 to distinguish it from regular tags
Add a small info tooltip icon next to the tag that explains: 'We cannot verify bulk-billing from this source. Always call the clinic to confirm.'
Verify the nudge appears on all Health topic cards when no price/billing tag is present
Verify the nudge does not appear on other topic cards
Verify regular price tags (e.g. '$', '$$') still render normally on Survive topic cards

description: Crisis lines are pinned at the top of the Health tab result list regardless of scroll position
steps: Define a CRISIS_LINES constant in lib/near-me.ts with entries for Lifeline (13 11 14), Beyond Blue (1300 22 4636), and 000 Emergency — each with name, phone, description, and a direct tel: link
In near-me-view.tsx, when topic === 'health', render a sticky CrisisLineBanner above the scrollable results list
Banner should be position sticky, top 0, z-10, with a soft amber or teal tinted background
Display 2-3 crisis lines as compact inline chips with a phone icon and the number
Banner persists at the top of the list panel while the user scrolls through results
Verify banner appears only on the Health tab
Verify crisis line phone chips are tappable and open the native dialler
Verify banner does not overlay or obscure the subtype filter chips

description: 'Came from a guide' context banner appears on Near Me when navigated via a Guide Bridge CTA deep-link
steps: Confirm /near-me page reads ?from=<guide-slug> and ?topic=<topic> from URL search params in app/near-me/page.tsx
Pass fromGuide: string | null as a prop to NearMeView
In near-me-view.tsx, when fromGuide is truthy, fetch the guide title from a guides metadata lookup by slug
Render a dismissable banner below the topic tabs: 'You're here after reading "<Guide Title>" — here are places near you.'
Style with bg-minuri-teal/8 border-l-4 border-minuri-teal text-minuri-mid px-4 py-3
Include an X button that clears the banner (stored in local state, does not change URL)
Verify banner appears when arriving from /guides/:arc/:slug via Bridge CTA
Verify banner does not appear on direct navigation to /near-me
Verify the correct topic tab is pre-selected based on the ?topic= param
Verify banner is dismissed permanently within the session when X is clicked

description: Users can save a Near Me place to localStorage via a heart icon, surfacing it later in the Landing hub
steps: Add a savePlaceToHub(place: NearMePlace) utility in lib/landing-local-state.ts that appends the place to a 'minuri-saved-places' localStorage key (max 20 entries, deduplicated by id)
In DetailList, CardGridList, and CompactList, add a heart (Heart icon from lucide-react) toggle button on each place row
Read current saved state from localStorage on render to determine filled vs outline heart
On click, toggle save state and animate the heart icon (scale 1 -> 1.3 -> 1 over 200ms)
In the mobile bottom sheet, also include the heart toggle button
In the Landing hub sidebar (components/landing/LandingHubSidebar), read 'minuri-saved-places' from localStorage and render up to 3 saved place chips in the 'Your <suburb>' section
Each chip shows topic icon, place name, and a one-tap link to /near-me?place=<id>&suburb=<suburb>
Verify saving a place persists across page reloads
Verify the heart icon reflects saved state correctly on page re-visit
Verify saved places appear in the Landing hub sidebar
Verify unsaving a place removes it from localStorage and from the hub
